messages.content: I'd like to take the campus shuttle to the Garden State Plaza on Saturday afternoon and come back that evening. What does the published schedule say?

expected_behaviors: Use the Saturday timetable and the actual stop sequence, not weekday departures.
Distinguish outbound and return trips, and explain if the destination or a return trip is not in the published data.
Treat a timetable as scheduled service rather than a live vehicle location or a guarantee of operation.

result.answer:
For Saturday, Sept. 19, the published Saturday Roadrunner Express shows Garden State Plaza stops at 2:15 PM, 6:00 PM, 8:00 PM, and 10:30 PM. If you want an afternoon trip out from campus, the afternoon option shown is depart campus at 1:40 PM and arrive Garden State Plaza at 2:15 PM. For an evening ride back from Garden State Plaza, the published options are 6:00 PM returning to campus at 6:35 PM, 8:00 PM returning at 8:45 PM, or 10:30 PM returning at 11:00 PM. [Transportation Services](https://www.ramapo.edu/about/transportation-services/ramapo-roadrunner-express-shuttle/)

This is the published timetable only; it does not confirm live delays or holiday/service changes. [Transportation Services](https://www.ramapo.edu/about/transportation-services/ramapo-roadrunner-express-shuttle/)

messages.content: What vegetarian options are on Birch's dinner menu today?

turns.user: What vegetarian options are on Birch's dinner menu today?
expected_behaviors: Read the correct dated menu or state its absence.

turns.user: Sorry, I meant lunch tomorrow, and vegan rather than vegetarian.
expected_behaviors: Replace the meal, date, and dietary preference while retaining Birch as the venue.
Do not recycle today's dinner options when tomorrow's lunch is unavailable.

turns.user: What time does it close that day?
expected_behaviors: Resolve it to Birch and that day to tomorrow; distinguish the venue's closing time from the lunch service end if the data separates them.
Read the correct dated menu or state its absence.

result.answer:
For dinner at Birch Tree Inn today, Wednesday, September 16, 2026, the published vegetarian items at Twists are Alfredo Sauce, Fresh Broccoli Florets, Marinara Sauce, and Penne Pasta. [Ramapo Dining](https://ramapo.sodexomyway.com/en-us/locations/birch-tree-inn)

At Spoonful and Grown, the vegetarian items listed are American Bounty Vegetable Soup and Garden Pot Pie. [Ramapo Dining](https://ramapo.sodexomyway.com/en-us/locations/birch-tree-inn)

At Sizzle, the vegetarian items listed are Black Bean Burger, Carnitas Coleslaw, Cheddar Cheese, Dill Pickle Chip, Hamburger Bun, Shredded Iceberg Lettuce, Sliced Red Onions, and Sliced Tomato. [Ramapo Dining](https://ramapo.sodexomyway.com/en-us/locations/birch-tree-inn)

At Stacked, the vegetarian items listed are American Cheese, Cheddar Cheese, Dill Pickle Chip, Hummus, Provolone Cheese, Shredded Lettuce, Sliced Fresh Red Onions, Sliced Tomato, and Swiss Cheese. [Ramapo Dining](https://ramapo.sodexomyway.com/en-us/locations/birch-tree-inn)

At Slices and Mix, the vegetarian items listed are Cheese Pizza, Citrus Spiced Lentil Salad, and Corn, Tomato & Basil Salad. [Ramapo Dining](https://ramapo.sodexomyway.com/en-us/locations/birch-tree-inn)

At Showcase, the vegetarian items listed are Cucumber Tomato Salad, Diced Green Peppers, Diced Red Pepper, Falafel Patty, Garlic Mayonnaise, Naan Bread, Shredded Lettuce, Sliced Black Olives, Steamed Basmati Rice, Tzatziki Sauce, and Vegan Lemon Garlic Aioli. [Ramapo Dining](https://ramapo.sodexomyway.com/en-us/locations/birch-tree-inn)

At Savory, the vegetarian items listed are Fresh Italian Parsley and Garlic Roasted Green Beans. [Ramapo Dining](https://ramapo.sodexomyway.com/en-us/locations/birch-tree-inn)

These are the dining service’s published vegetarian labels for today’s dinner menu and are not an allergy-safety guarantee. [Ramapo Dining](https://ramapo.sodexomyway.com/en-us/locations/birch-tree-inn)
